items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Eddie Sauter) only responds to the interviewer's statements about Don Sebesky's opinions on Sauter's work. There is no evidence of direct personal interaction, collaboration, or mentorship between Sauter and Sebesky in the transcript.

ctx.x: No, it couldn't be if they were writing around.
Unless what they did was Sebesky took over (inaudible).
I guess there's more than one side to a problem like that.
